title: Exchange-Rate Margins and Rate Lock Periods for Mobile Wallet Tiers
content:
Treasury rate card for the **Mobile Wallet** product. The margin is the percentage below the mid-market rate at which a tier converts; a reduced margin applies to larger principals; the rate lock is how long a quoted rate stays guaranteed while funds are awaited.

| Tier | Exchange-rate margin below mid-market (percent) | Principal at or above which the reduced margin applies (USD) | Percentage points taken off the margin at or above that principal | Rate lock (hours from booking) | Inbound wire deadline (hours from booking) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 1.95 | 100.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 1.15 | 2000.00 | 0.10 | 96 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 1.70 | 1500.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 1.30 | 3000.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 1.55 | 1500.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 0.95 | 3000.00 | 0.10 | 48 | 48 |

Notes on the columns:

- The reduction is stated in percentage points and is taken off the tier's margin itself; it applies to a principal **at or above** the threshold.
- The rate lock runs for the stated number of hours from the moment the transfer was booked, while funds are awaited.
- The inbound wire deadline is the number of hours after booking within which a wire must arrive; 0 means the deadline does not apply on that tier.

### Threshold illustrations (hypothetical principals)

| Tier | Principal | Margin that applies |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Express | 1499.99 | 1.70 percent |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 1500.00 | 1.60 percent (1.70 less 0.10 points) |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 2000.00 | 1.05 percent (1.15 less 0.10 points) |
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 100.00 | 1.95 percent (the reduction on Micro is 0.00 points) |
